label: V1b — continuous scrubbed wood trial
prompt:
Edit the supplied book cover, keeping its current V1a layout and every word, letter size, position, vegetable and sticker composition. The ONLY design change is to harmonise the background behind the central typography with the scrubbed painted wooden surface already visible behind the vegetables at the top and bottom.
Replace the smooth cream central panel with an exceptionally pale, lightly whitewashed sage/ivory wood surface. It should feel like the SAME continuous softly lit scrubbed wooden tabletop running behind the whole cover, joining the upper and lower backgrounds without obvious horizontal panel-cut lines. Match their predominantly horizontal grain direction, fine sparse rubbed paint streaks and warm daylight. In the centre the texture should be quiet and low contrast: mostly warm ivory with a whisper of sage, delicate irregular horizontal brush/grain traces visible in the open margins and between words. Keep the reading area bright and clean. No dark plank seams, prominent knots, grime, heavy scratches, busy grain, stippled noise, cloudy mottling or yellow/brown antique distress. Do not turn it into a separate sign or framed panel.
Retain exact photographic vegetable arrangements, colours and sharp detail: tomatoes/red onion/peas above, carrots/purple-stemmed kale below. Keep the sprigs, tendrils and carrot fronds naturally overlapping into the centre as they are now. Do not resize or move them. Preserve the very large dark green title 'The Vegetable Guru', its small green leaf emblem, the smaller centred two-line subtitle 'Your at-a-glance' / 'growing companion', and 'John Lennon'. All typography stays solid, crisp and high contrast on top of the pale wood; do not apply weathering to the letters. Preserve the smaller lower-right circular YouTube sticker's size, placement, slight clockwise tilt, crisp neutral white face and red play logo, with the exact words 'As seen on' / 'YouTube' / '@Hackriculture'. The wood must NOT appear on the sticker. Keep all original margins and proportions. No new ribbon, badge, text, version label or border.
Flat full-bleed front cover, same approximately 185:240 portrait aspect ratio. This is a subtle central-background material edit, not a redraw or restyling of the foreground artwork. Preserve existing foreground detail and avoid introducing generative texture changes.
